summary.text: Ramon Romero is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 90 who has served since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Ballotpedia lists no opponent.

paragraphs.text: Ramon Romero Jr. attended Poly High School, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as construction.
His professional experience includes owning A-Fast Coping Tile and Stone and earning a Texas irrigator license in 1994.
He assumed office in the Texas House in 2015, and for 2023-2024 was assigned to the House Transportation and Urban Affairs committees.
